01 — The Floor

Iron, not
machines for show.

No rows of treadmills. No crowds fighting for a bench. A focused floor of serious equipment, chosen for lifters — from first-timers finding their feet to seasoned bodybuilders chasing the next plate.

01 / Free Weights

Free Weights

Barbells, plates and dumbbells up to 160 lb — the heavy end most commercial gyms never stock. Lift properly, without waiting around.

Dumbbells to 160 lb
02 / Olympic Lifting

Olympic Platforms

Olympic weights and platforms built for real pulling and pressing. Chalk, plates and space to do the work — no apologies needed.

Platforms & Olympic bars
03 / Machines

Plate-Loaded Machines

Resistance and plate-loaded machines that load the muscle, not the ego — plus squat racks, cable stations and a leg press.

Squat racks · Leg press
04 / Coaching

Personal Training

Guided, one-to-one coaching from friendly, knowledgeable staff. Whether your goal is size, strength or simply better health, you’ll get a plan — and someone in your corner.

1-to-1 coaching
05 / Open Gym

Open Gym Sessions

Come in, warm up and train your own way. Open gym suits every level — lose weight, gain muscle or build strength, at your own pace.

Train your way
06 / Recovery

Cardio & Changing

Cardio machines for warm-ups and conditioning, plus showers, lockers and changing rooms so you can train before work and walk out fresh.

Showers · Lockers

02 — Why Spartan

Small gym.
Personal touch.

02
I

Bodybuilding Focused

Built for people who take training seriously — not a leisure centre with a gym attached. Every piece of kit earns its floor space.

II

Everyone Welcome

Beginners, returners, competitors — all training side by side. The atmosphere is friendly, the staff are helpful, and nobody judges your starting point.

III

Supportive Community

A proper old-school gym where people know your name and spot your last rep. Discipline, respect and determination — built into the walls.

03 — Visit Us

Come and
see the floor.

Just outside the city centre on Restalrig Road, a short walk from Restalrig Circus bus stop. Drop in, call, or email — the kettle’s on and the plates are waiting.
